title: Degree-seven joint Witt shifted-trace closed form
statement: For every q=2^r, r>=1, at (ell,n,c)=(3,7,2) the complete high-character correlation summed over exact low-twist conductor one is zero, while the exact-conductor-two high-character trace is q^9(q-1)^2. Its q-degree is 11, exactly one below the formal top degree 12.

evidence.supports: The q-ary conditional-covariance derivation, both exact-conductor layers, their high-character normalization, and independent full enumeration over GF(2) and GF(4).
evidence.notes: The universal step substitutes the two-valued degree-seven class population into the exact conditional covariance. Enumeration at q=2 and q=4 is a mutation control, not quantifier evidence.

provenance.source: exact characteristic-two extension-field class populations and q-ary Fourier orthogonality

notes: This proves that affine-shell dimension alone cannot yield repeated weight drops in the joint Witt shifted trace. It does not refute a growing-conductor WITT-LOW estimate using cross-layer or Mobius cancellation and supplies no Lemire theorem credit.
